content: To reset a password, open the sign-in page, select Forgot password, enter the registered email, and follow the verification link. The link expires after 30 minutes.
Use a unique password and enable two-factor authentication. Never share passwords or one-time verification codes. Review active sessions after a suspected security issue.
Sign in, open Billing, choose Payment history, select a transaction, and click Download invoice. Invoices are available as PDF files.
Credit and debit cards are supported. Add or update a payment method under Settings, Billing, and Payment methods.
To cancel, open Settings, select Plan, choose Manage subscription, and select Cancel plan. Access remains until the end of the paid billing period.
Submit a refund request from Help Center, Billing, and Request a refund. Include the invoice number and explanation. Eligibility depends on purchase terms and review.
Enable two-factor authentication from Settings, Security, and Two-factor authentication. Use an authenticator app and store recovery codes securely.
Collect the exact error message, time, browser version, and reproduction steps. Contact support through Help Center. Do not share passwords or private tokens.
Open Settings, Profile, and Edit email. Verify the new address using the confirmation message. The old address remains active until verification succeeds.
Open Settings, Privacy, and Request data export. A download link is sent to the verified account email when ready.
